sources.snippet: Download bge-small-en-v1.5 for free. Compact English sentence embedding model for semantic search tasks. BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 is a lightweight English sentence embedding model developed by the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI) as part of the BGE (BAAI General Embedding) series.
